corpus.note: 05-rag-and-chat.md and 06-roadmap.md exist in docs/ but are NOT in this index — Gemini free-tier embedding quota blocked them during seeding. Cases whose evidence lives only in those two files are marked kind=off-corpus-current-index and are expected to abstain against THIS index while being answerable against the full one. They are kept separate from genuinely unanswerable cases so the two are never confused.

notes: Expected evidence names the document a correct answer must cite. Every fact below was read out of the file named, not recalled. Cases carry no expected answer text: this harness measures retrieval and abstention, and an expected-answer string would invite grading a model against one phrasing of a correct answer.
